zh-CN.explanation:
确定各税档适用收入。分段计算税额而非全部收入乘最高税率。用转移和税收比较最终购买能力。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：边际税率只适用于新增收入，不应把最高档税率乘全部收入。累进税意味着平均税率随收入上升，定向转移支付则增加合资格家庭的可支配收入。税额和平均税率的数值计算属于 HL。

最高边际税率不应直接乘以全部收入。

区分收入、财富、贫困与不平等，评价针对性、激励与公平标准。

en.hlExtension: Illustrative example: the first 100 is tax-free and the next 100 taxed at 20%. Income of 200 yields tax 20, average rate 10% and marginal rate 20%. A transfer of 15 gives disposable income 195. Indirect taxes, avoidance and services also affect distribution.
en.title: Progressive taxes, transfers and disposable income
en.takeaway: Under progressive taxation the average tax rate rises with income. The marginal rate applies to additional income; the average rate is total tax/income. Disposable income subtracts direct taxes and adds transfers.
en.definition: Under progressive taxation the average tax rate rises with income. The marginal rate applies to additional income; the average rate is total tax/income. Disposable income subtracts direct taxes and adds transfers.
causalChain: Identify income within each bracket
calculate tax progressively rather than applying the top rate to all income
compare purchasing power after taxes and transfers
misconceptions: Do not apply the highest marginal rate to all income.
examApplication: Distinguish income, wealth, poverty and inequality; evaluate targeting, incentives and equity criteria.
summary: Under progressive taxation the average tax rate rises with income. The marginal rate applies to additional income; the average rate is total tax/income. Disposable income subtracts direct taxes and adds transfers.
Do not apply the highest marginal rate to all income.
en.explanation:
Identify income within each bracket.  calculate tax progressively rather than applying the top rate to all income.  compare purchasing power after taxes and transfers.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: a marginal rate applies to additional income, not automatically all income. Under progressive taxation the average rate rises with income; targeted transfers add to eligible households’ disposable income. Numerical tax and average-rate calculations are HL.

Do not apply the highest marginal rate to all income.

Distinguish income, wealth, poverty and inequality; evaluate targeting, incentives and equity criteria.

zh-CN.title: 减贫与再分配政策评价
zh-CN.takeaway: 税转移、教育医疗、就业支持、最低工资和社会保险可改变贫困与分配；应比较覆盖、激励、成本、服务质量和长期机会。
zh-CN.definition: 税转移、教育医疗、就业支持、最低工资和社会保险可改变贫困与分配；应比较覆盖、激励、成本、服务质量和长期机会。
causalChain: 识别收入或机会障碍
选择现金、服务或制度工具
用受益分布及行为反应评估结果
misconceptions: 转移金额增加不等于实际贫困一定同幅减少。
examApplication: 区分收入、财富、贫困与不平等，评价针对性、激励与公平标准。
summary: 税转移、教育医疗、就业支持、最低工资和社会保险可改变贫困与分配；应比较覆盖、激励、成本、服务质量和长期机会。
转移金额增加不等于实际贫困一定同幅减少。
zh-CN.explanation:
识别收入或机会障碍。选择现金、服务或制度工具。用受益分布及行为反应评估结果。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：收入审查补助提高针对性，却可能遗漏无完整收入记录的家庭；逐步退出补助可减轻福利悬崖。普遍公共教育覆盖更广，但若地区质量差异大，名义免费并不保证机会平等。

转移金额增加不等于实际贫困一定同幅减少。

区分收入、财富、贫困与不平等，评价针对性、激励与公平标准。

en.title: Evaluating poverty and redistribution policies
en.takeaway: Taxes/transfers, education and health, employment support, minimum wages and social insurance can alter poverty and distribution. Compare coverage, incentives, cost, quality and long-run opportunity.
en.definition: Taxes/transfers, education and health, employment support, minimum wages and social insurance can alter poverty and distribution. Compare coverage, incentives, cost, quality and long-run opportunity.
causalChain: Identify income or opportunity barriers
choose cash, services or institutional tools
assess benefit distribution and behavioural responses
misconceptions: A larger transfer does not necessarily reduce real poverty by the same proportion.
examApplication: Distinguish income, wealth, poverty and inequality; evaluate targeting, incentives and equity criteria.
summary: Taxes/transfers, education and health, employment support, minimum wages and social insurance can alter poverty and distribution. Compare coverage, incentives, cost, quality and long-run opportunity.
A larger transfer does not necessarily reduce real poverty by the same proportion.
en.explanation:
Identify income or opportunity barriers.  choose cash, services or institutional tools.  assess benefit distribution and behavioural responses.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: means-tested support improves targeting but may miss households without records; tapering benefits can reduce benefit cliffs. Universal schooling reaches more people, but unequal local quality means nominally free provision need not equalise opportunity.

A larger transfer does not necessarily reduce real poverty by the same proportion.

Distinguish income, wealth, poverty and inequality; evaluate targeting, incentives and equity criteria.

zh-CN.title: 中央银行与利率
zh-CN.takeaway: 中央银行通过政策利率及金融条件影响支出；实际利率近似等于名义利率减预期通胀率。
zh-CN.definition: 中央银行通过政策利率及金融条件影响支出；实际利率近似等于名义利率减预期通胀率。
causalChain: 政策利率影响市场融资成本
借贷者比较实际成本
消费和投资计划随之调整
misconceptions: 实际利率应使用预期通胀分析事前决策。
examApplication: 用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。
summary: 中央银行通过政策利率及金融条件影响支出；实际利率近似等于名义利率减预期通胀率。
实际利率应使用预期通胀分析事前决策。
zh-CN.explanation:
政策利率影响市场融资成本。借贷者比较实际成本。消费和投资计划随之调整。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：名义贷款利率 6%、预期通胀 2%，近似实际利率为 4%。银行风险溢价上升时，贷款利率未必与政策利率同步下降。货币不是收入，新增贷款也不直接等于新增产出。

实际利率应使用预期通胀分析事前决策。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Central banks and interest rates
en.takeaway: Central banks influence spending through policy rates and financial conditions. The real interest rate is approximately the nominal rate minus expected inflation.
en.definition: Central banks influence spending through policy rates and financial conditions. The real interest rate is approximately the nominal rate minus expected inflation.
causalChain: Policy rates influence market financing costs
borrowers compare real costs
consumption and investment plans adjust
misconceptions: Use expected inflation when analysing ex-ante real rates.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: Central banks influence spending through policy rates and financial conditions. The real interest rate is approximately the nominal rate minus expected inflation.
Use expected inflation when analysing ex-ante real rates.
en.explanation:
Policy rates influence market financing costs.  borrowers compare real costs.  consumption and investment plans adjust.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: a 6% nominal lending rate and 2% expected inflation imply an approximately 4% real rate. If bank risk premiums rise, lending rates need not fall alongside policy rates. Money is not income, and new lending does not directly equal new output.

Use expected inflation when analysing ex-ante real rates.

Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.

zh-CN.title: 货币政策传导
zh-CN.takeaway: 利率通过借贷、储蓄、资产价格、预期和汇率等渠道影响总需求；效果有时滞且取决于金融与汇率制度。
zh-CN.definition: 利率通过借贷、储蓄、资产价格、预期和汇率等渠道影响总需求；效果有时滞且取决于金融与汇率制度。
causalChain: 利率改变融资与储蓄回报
家庭企业调整消费投资
总需求变化影响实际产出和物价
misconceptions: 降息不保证汇率或投资按固定幅度变化。
examApplication: 用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。
summary: 利率通过借贷、储蓄、资产价格、预期和汇率等渠道影响总需求；效果有时滞且取决于金融与汇率制度。
降息不保证汇率或投资按固定幅度变化。
zh-CN.explanation:
利率改变融资与储蓄回报。家庭企业调整消费投资。总需求变化影响实际产出和物价。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：浮动汇率下，相对利率下降可能减少资本流入并使货币贬值，从而支持净出口；但进口成本也会上升。固定利率房贷较多时，家庭现金流反应可能较慢。

降息不保证汇率或投资按固定幅度变化。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Monetary transmission
en.takeaway: Interest rates affect aggregate demand through borrowing, saving, asset prices, expectations and exchange rates. Effects have lags and depend on financial and exchange-rate arrangements.
en.definition: Interest rates affect aggregate demand through borrowing, saving, asset prices, expectations and exchange rates. Effects have lags and depend on financial and exchange-rate arrangements.
causalChain: Rates change financing costs and saving returns
households and firms adjust consumption and investment
changing aggregate demand affects output and prices
misconceptions: A rate cut does not guarantee a fixed exchange-rate or investment response.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: Interest rates affect aggregate demand through borrowing, saving, asset prices, expectations and exchange rates. Effects have lags and depend on financial and exchange-rate arrangements.
A rate cut does not guarantee a fixed exchange-rate or investment response.
en.explanation:
Rates change financing costs and saving returns.  households and firms adjust consumption and investment.  changing aggregate demand affects output and prices.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: under floating exchange rates, lower relative interest may reduce capital inflows and depreciate the currency, supporting net exports while raising import costs. Household cash-flow responses may be slower where fixed-rate mortgages dominate.

A rate cut does not guarantee a fixed exchange-rate or investment response.

Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.

zh-CN.title: 扩张性货币政策
zh-CN.takeaway: 扩张性货币政策放松金融条件以支持总需求，通常用于需求不足；产出与物价反应取决于闲置产能。
zh-CN.definition: 扩张性货币政策放松金融条件以支持总需求，通常用于需求不足；产出与物价反应取决于闲置产能。
causalChain: 降低利率或放松信贷条件
利率敏感支出增加使总需求右移
负产出缺口可能缩小
misconceptions: 总需求右移不是潜在产出自动增加。
examApplication: 用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。
summary: 扩张性货币政策放松金融条件以支持总需求，通常用于需求不足；产出与物价反应取决于闲置产能。
总需求右移不是潜在产出自动增加。
zh-CN.explanation:
降低利率或放松信贷条件。利率敏感支出增加使总需求右移。负产出缺口可能缩小。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：经济存在闲置设备时，融资成本下降使企业恢复部分投资，产量与就业增加。若银行仍限制贷款或家庭偿债，需求增幅可能较小；接近产能上限时，物价压力更大。

总需求右移不是潜在产出自动增加。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Expansionary monetary policy
en.takeaway: Expansionary monetary policy eases financial conditions to support aggregate demand, usually when demand is weak. Output and price responses depend on spare capacity.
en.definition: Expansionary monetary policy eases financial conditions to support aggregate demand, usually when demand is weak. Output and price responses depend on spare capacity.
causalChain: Lower interest rates or ease credit conditions
interest-sensitive spending increases and aggregate demand shifts right
a negative output gap may narrow
misconceptions: A rightward AD shift does not automatically increase potential output.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: Expansionary monetary policy eases financial conditions to support aggregate demand, usually when demand is weak. Output and price responses depend on spare capacity.
A rightward AD shift does not automatically increase potential output.
en.explanation:
Lower interest rates or ease credit conditions.  interest-sensitive spending increases and aggregate demand shifts right.  a negative output gap may narrow.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: with idle equipment, cheaper finance restores some investment, raising output and employment. Demand may respond weakly if banks restrict lending or households repay debt. Near capacity, price pressure is greater.

A rightward AD shift does not automatically increase potential output.

Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.

zh-CN.title: 紧缩性货币政策
zh-CN.takeaway: 紧缩性货币政策提高融资成本或收紧金融条件以减弱总需求和通胀压力，但可能牺牲短期产出与就业。
zh-CN.definition: 紧缩性货币政策提高融资成本或收紧金融条件以减弱总需求和通胀压力，但可能牺牲短期产出与就业。
causalChain: 提高政策利率
消费投资增速减弱使总需求相对降低
通胀压力下降但周期性失业可能增加
misconceptions: 抑制通胀通常指降低涨价速度，不等于物价水平下降。
examApplication: 用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。
summary: 紧缩性货币政策提高融资成本或收紧金融条件以减弱总需求和通胀压力，但可能牺牲短期产出与就业。
抑制通胀通常指降低涨价速度，不等于物价水平下降。
zh-CN.explanation:
提高政策利率。消费投资增速减弱使总需求相对降低。通胀压力下降但周期性失业可能增加。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：为缓和过热需求而加息后，住宅投资放缓。若通胀来自能源供给中断，加息不能直接恢复能源供给，降低通胀可能需要更大的产出代价。固定利率合同也会延迟影响。

抑制通胀通常指降低涨价速度，不等于物价水平下降。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Contractionary monetary policy
en.takeaway: Contractionary monetary policy raises financing costs or tightens financial conditions to weaken aggregate demand and inflation pressure, potentially sacrificing short-run output and employment.
en.definition: Contractionary monetary policy raises financing costs or tightens financial conditions to weaken aggregate demand and inflation pressure, potentially sacrificing short-run output and employment.
causalChain: Raise policy interest rates
consumption and investment weaken and aggregate demand is lower than otherwise
inflation pressure falls but cyclical unemployment may rise
misconceptions: Reducing inflation usually means slower price increases, not a falling price level.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: Contractionary monetary policy raises financing costs or tightens financial conditions to weaken aggregate demand and inflation pressure, potentially sacrificing short-run output and employment.
Reducing inflation usually means slower price increases, not a falling price level.
en.explanation:
Raise policy interest rates.  consumption and investment weaken and aggregate demand is lower than otherwise.  inflation pressure falls but cyclical unemployment may rise.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: higher rates intended to cool excessive demand slow housing investment. If inflation reflects an energy supply disruption, tightening cannot directly restore energy supply and may entail a larger output cost. Fixed-rate contracts can delay the effect.

Reducing inflation usually means slower price increases, not a falling price level.

Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.

zh-CN.title: 非常规货币政策
zh-CN.takeaway: 量化宽松等工具在常规降息空间有限时影响资产收益率、流动性和预期；购买金融资产不等同于政府购买商品服务。
zh-CN.definition: 量化宽松等工具在常规降息空间有限时影响资产收益率、流动性和预期；购买金融资产不等同于政府购买商品服务。
causalChain: 中央银行购买金融资产
资产价格和流动性变化影响融资条件
支出反应取决于信贷需求与信心
misconceptions: 准备金增长不等于消费、贷款或 CPI 按相同比例增长。
examApplication: 用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。
summary: 量化宽松等工具在常规降息空间有限时影响资产收益率、流动性和预期；购买金融资产不等同于政府购买商品服务。
准备金增长不等于消费、贷款或 CPI 按相同比例增长。
zh-CN.explanation:
中央银行购买金融资产。资产价格和流动性变化影响融资条件。支出反应取决于信贷需求与信心。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：中央银行购买长期债券可能压低长期收益率，但商业银行不会仅因准备金增加就必然扩大贷款。资产价格上涨还可能使资产持有者受益更多，退出政策时也有市场风险。

准备金增长不等于消费、贷款或 CPI 按相同比例增长。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Unconventional monetary policy
en.takeaway: Tools such as quantitative easing influence asset yields, liquidity and expectations when conventional rate cuts have limited room. Financial asset purchases are not government purchases of goods and services.
en.definition: Tools such as quantitative easing influence asset yields, liquidity and expectations when conventional rate cuts have limited room. Financial asset purchases are not government purchases of goods and services.
causalChain: The central bank buys financial assets
asset prices and liquidity alter financing conditions
spending responses depend on credit demand and confidence
misconceptions: Reserve growth is not proportional growth in consumption, lending or CPI.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: Tools such as quantitative easing influence asset yields, liquidity and expectations when conventional rate cuts have limited room. Financial asset purchases are not government purchases of goods and services.
Reserve growth is not proportional growth in consumption, lending or CPI.
en.explanation:
The central bank buys financial assets.  asset prices and liquidity alter financing conditions.  spending responses depend on credit demand and confidence.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: central-bank purchases of long-term bonds may lower long-term yields, but more reserves do not compel banks to lend. Asset price increases may benefit asset owners disproportionately, and policy reversal can create market risks.

Reserve growth is not proportional growth in consumption, lending or CPI.

Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.

zh-CN.title: 货币政策的有效性与约束
zh-CN.takeaway: 货币政策效果取决于信心、债务、银行传导、预期、开放程度和冲击来源；独立性与可信度也影响政策结果。
zh-CN.definition: 货币政策效果取决于信心、债务、银行传导、预期、开放程度和冲击来源；独立性与可信度也影响政策结果。
causalChain: 识别需求或供给问题
检查金融渠道与时滞
比较通胀就业分配及金融稳定的权衡
misconceptions: 同一利率对储户、借款者和不同地区影响不同。
examApplication: 用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。
summary: 货币政策效果取决于信心、债务、银行传导、预期、开放程度和冲击来源；独立性与可信度也影响政策结果。
同一利率对储户、借款者和不同地区影响不同。
zh-CN.explanation:
识别需求或供给问题。检查金融渠道与时滞。比较通胀就业分配及金融稳定的权衡。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：衰退中企业预期销售低迷，利率接近有效下限时再小幅降息未必恢复投资。可信的通胀目标可稳定预期，但独立性并不意味着政策没有问责或不受供给冲击影响。

同一利率对储户、借款者和不同地区影响不同。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Effectiveness and limits of monetary policy
en.takeaway: Monetary effectiveness depends on confidence, debt, bank transmission, expectations, openness and the source of shocks. Independence and credibility also influence outcomes.
en.definition: Monetary effectiveness depends on confidence, debt, bank transmission, expectations, openness and the source of shocks. Independence and credibility also influence outcomes.
causalChain: Identify demand or supply problems
examine financial channels and lags
compare trade-offs involving inflation, employment, distribution and financial stability
misconceptions: The same interest rate affects savers, borrowers and regions differently.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: Monetary effectiveness depends on confidence, debt, bank transmission, expectations, openness and the source of shocks. Independence and credibility also influence outcomes.
The same interest rate affects savers, borrowers and regions differently.
en.explanation:
Identify demand or supply problems.  examine financial channels and lags.  compare trade-offs involving inflation, employment, distribution and financial stability.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: in recession, firms expecting weak sales may not revive investment after a small cut near the effective lower bound. A credible inflation target can anchor expectations, but independence does not remove accountability or exposure to supply shocks.

The same interest rate affects savers, borrowers and regions differently.

Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.

zh-CN.title: 财政预算与政策立场
zh-CN.takeaway: 财政政策通过政府支出和税收影响需求与分配；赤字是期间流量，公共债务是时点存量，预算余额也受经济周期影响。
zh-CN.definition: 财政政策通过政府支出和税收影响需求与分配；赤字是期间流量，公共债务是时点存量，预算余额也受经济周期影响。
causalChain: 支出与收入形成预算余额
衰退减少税收并增加部分转移
辨别自动变化和主动政策立场
misconceptions: 预算盈余或赤字的绝对水平不能单独识别政策变化。
examApplication: 区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。
summary: 财政政策通过政府支出和税收影响需求与分配；赤字是期间流量，公共债务是时点存量，预算余额也受经济周期影响。
预算盈余或赤字的绝对水平不能单独识别政策变化。
zh-CN.explanation:
支出与收入形成预算余额。衰退减少税收并增加部分转移。辨别自动变化和主动政策立场。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：收入 90、支出 100，期间赤字为 10；这不是债务总额。衰退导致的赤字扩大不一定意味着政府新宣布刺激计划。结构性余额尝试剔除周期影响，但依赖潜在产出的估算。

预算盈余或赤字的绝对水平不能单独识别政策变化。

区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。

en.title: Fiscal budgets and policy stance
en.takeaway: Fiscal policy affects demand and distribution through government spending and taxation. A deficit is a flow, public debt a stock, and the economic cycle also affects the budget balance.
en.definition: Fiscal policy affects demand and distribution through government spending and taxation. A deficit is a flow, public debt a stock, and the economic cycle also affects the budget balance.
causalChain: Spending and revenue determine the budget balance
recession lowers taxes and raises some transfers
distinguish automatic changes from discretionary policy stance
misconceptions: The level of a surplus or deficit alone cannot identify a policy change.
examApplication: Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.
summary: Fiscal policy affects demand and distribution through government spending and taxation. A deficit is a flow, public debt a stock, and the economic cycle also affects the budget balance.
The level of a surplus or deficit alone cannot identify a policy change.
en.explanation:
Spending and revenue determine the budget balance.  recession lowers taxes and raises some transfers.  distinguish automatic changes from discretionary policy stance.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: revenue of 90 and spending of 100 imply a period deficit of 10, not total debt. A recession-driven larger deficit need not mean a newly announced stimulus. Structural balances try to remove cyclical effects but depend on estimated potential output.

The level of a surplus or deficit alone cannot identify a policy change.

Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.

zh-CN.title: 扩张性财政政策
zh-CN.takeaway: 增加政府购买、减税或增加转移可支持总需求；政府购买直接计入 G，转移支付则通过受益者支出间接影响需求。
zh-CN.definition: 增加政府购买、减税或增加转移可支持总需求；政府购买直接计入 G，转移支付则通过受益者支出间接影响需求。
causalChain: 增加购买或提高可支配收入
初始支出带来收入及后续消费
总需求右移并可能缩小衰退缺口
misconceptions: 转移支付不是国民收入核算中的政府最终购买。
examApplication: 区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。
summary: 增加政府购买、减税或增加转移可支持总需求；政府购买直接计入 G，转移支付则通过受益者支出间接影响需求。
转移支付不是国民收入核算中的政府最终购买。
zh-CN.explanation:
增加购买或提高可支配收入。初始支出带来收入及后续消费。总需求右移并可能缩小衰退缺口。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：政府维修公共设施直接增加采购，给家庭补助则只有被消费的部分形成当期需求。闲置资源多时产出反应可能较大，进口泄漏、储蓄和执行延迟会削弱国内效果。

转移支付不是国民收入核算中的政府最终购买。

区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。

en.title: Expansionary fiscal policy
en.takeaway: Higher government purchases, tax cuts or transfers can support aggregate demand. Purchases enter G directly; transfers affect demand indirectly through recipients' spending.
en.definition: Higher government purchases, tax cuts or transfers can support aggregate demand. Purchases enter G directly; transfers affect demand indirectly through recipients' spending.
causalChain: Increase purchases or disposable income
initial spending creates income and further consumption
aggregate demand shifts right and may narrow a recessionary gap
misconceptions: Transfers are not government final purchases in national accounting.
examApplication: Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.
summary: Higher government purchases, tax cuts or transfers can support aggregate demand. Purchases enter G directly; transfers affect demand indirectly through recipients' spending.
Transfers are not government final purchases in national accounting.
en.explanation:
Increase purchases or disposable income.  initial spending creates income and further consumption.  aggregate demand shifts right and may narrow a recessionary gap.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: repairs to public facilities directly raise purchases, whereas only the spent portion of household support generates current demand. Output may respond more with idle resources; imports, saving and implementation delays weaken domestic effects.

Transfers are not government final purchases in national accounting.

Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.

zh-CN.title: 紧缩性财政政策
zh-CN.takeaway: 削减支出或增税可降低总需求以缓和过热或改善财政状况；对产出、分配与长期供给的影响取决于措施构成。
zh-CN.definition: 削减支出或增税可降低总需求以缓和过热或改善财政状况；对产出、分配与长期供给的影响取决于措施构成。
causalChain: 削减购买或提高税收
直接需求或可支配收入降低
总需求相对左移使通胀压力减弱
misconceptions: 财政改善的直接核算效果与最终宏观效果应区分。
examApplication: 区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。
summary: 削减支出或增税可降低总需求以缓和过热或改善财政状况；对产出、分配与长期供给的影响取决于措施构成。
财政改善的直接核算效果与最终宏观效果应区分。
zh-CN.explanation:
削减购买或提高税收。直接需求或可支配收入降低。总需求相对左移使通胀压力减弱。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：过热时提高收入税可能抑制消费，但若削减的是有效培训预算，也可能损害长期生产能力。衰退中紧缩可能降低税基，因此不能假定支出每减一单位，赤字就必减一单位。

财政改善的直接核算效果与最终宏观效果应区分。

区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。

en.title: Contractionary fiscal policy
en.takeaway: Spending cuts or tax rises can lower aggregate demand to cool overheating or improve fiscal balances. Output, distribution and long-run supply effects depend on the policy mix.
en.definition: Spending cuts or tax rises can lower aggregate demand to cool overheating or improve fiscal balances. Output, distribution and long-run supply effects depend on the policy mix.
causalChain: Cut purchases or raise taxes
direct demand or disposable income falls
aggregate demand shifts relatively left and inflation pressure weakens
misconceptions: Distinguish direct accounting effects from final macroeconomic effects.
examApplication: Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.
summary: Spending cuts or tax rises can lower aggregate demand to cool overheating or improve fiscal balances. Output, distribution and long-run supply effects depend on the policy mix.
Distinguish direct accounting effects from final macroeconomic effects.
en.explanation:
Cut purchases or raise taxes.  direct demand or disposable income falls.  aggregate demand shifts relatively left and inflation pressure weakens.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: higher income tax during overheating may restrain consumption, but cutting effective training may also damage long-run capacity. In recession, tightening may shrink the tax base, so a unit spending cut need not reduce the deficit by a full unit.

Distinguish direct accounting effects from final macroeconomic effects.

Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.

zh-CN.title: 自动稳定器
zh-CN.takeaway: 税收与符合资格的转移随收入和就业自动变化，可缓和周期波动，无须每次通过新的主动决策。
zh-CN.definition: 税收与符合资格的转移随收入和就业自动变化，可缓和周期波动，无须每次通过新的主动决策。
causalChain: 衰退降低税款并提高部分福利支出
可支配收入跌幅得到缓冲
消费与总需求的下降减弱
misconceptions: 自动不等于没有制度设计，也不等于新刺激法案。
examApplication: 区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。
summary: 税收与符合资格的转移随收入和就业自动变化，可缓和周期波动，无须每次通过新的主动决策。
自动不等于没有制度设计，也不等于新刺激法案。
zh-CN.explanation:
衰退降低税款并提高部分福利支出。可支配收入跌幅得到缓冲。消费与总需求的下降减弱。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：失业增加后，原有失业保险规则自动支付更多补助，预算趋向赤字。它缓冲而非消除衰退；覆盖有限、资格限制或低替代率会削弱稳定作用。景气时税收回升则有反向作用。

自动不等于没有制度设计，也不等于新刺激法案。

区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。

en.title: Automatic stabilisers
en.takeaway: Taxes and eligible transfers change automatically with income and employment, moderating cyclical fluctuations without a fresh discretionary decision each time.
en.definition: Taxes and eligible transfers change automatically with income and employment, moderating cyclical fluctuations without a fresh discretionary decision each time.
causalChain: Recession lowers tax payments and raises some benefits
disposable income falls less sharply
consumption and aggregate demand decline less
misconceptions: Automatic does not mean undesigned or a new stimulus law.
examApplication: Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.
summary: Taxes and eligible transfers change automatically with income and employment, moderating cyclical fluctuations without a fresh discretionary decision each time.
Automatic does not mean undesigned or a new stimulus law.
en.explanation:
Recession lowers tax payments and raises some benefits.  disposable income falls less sharply.  consumption and aggregate demand decline less.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: existing unemployment insurance rules automatically pay more benefits as unemployment rises, pushing the budget toward deficit. They cushion rather than eliminate recession; limited coverage, eligibility restrictions or low replacement rates weaken stabilisation. Recovering tax revenues work in reverse during expansion.

Automatic does not mean undesigned or a new stimulus law.

Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.

zh-CN.title: 凯恩斯乘数
zh-CN.takeaway: 简单开放经济模型中，边际漏出以同一新增收入为基数时，乘数 k = 1/(MPS + MPT + MPM)，收入变化为 k 乘初始自主支出变化。
zh-CN.definition: 简单开放经济模型中，边际漏出以同一新增收入为基数时，乘数 k = 1/(MPS + MPT + MPM)，收入变化为 k 乘初始自主支出变化。
causalChain: 自主支出创造首轮收入
部分收入形成下一轮国内支出
储蓄税收进口使后续轮次逐渐缩小
misconceptions: 不要混用税前与税后收入口径的边际倾向。
examApplication: 区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。
summary: 简单开放经济模型中，边际漏出以同一新增收入为基数时，乘数 k = 1/(MPS + MPT + MPM)，收入变化为 k 乘初始自主支出变化。
不要混用税前与税后收入口径的边际倾向。
zh-CN.explanation:
自主支出创造首轮收入。部分收入形成下一轮国内支出。储蓄税收进口使后续轮次逐渐缩小。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：以同一新增总收入为基数，MPS=0.2、MPT=0.1、MPM=0.2，k=2，新增政府购买 10 对应模型收入增加 20。封闭无政府模型 k=1/(1−MPC)。若 c 是可支配收入的消费倾向、t 为总收入比例税率、m 为总收入进口倾向，则 k=1/[1−c(1−t)+m]；不能混用基数。模型假定闲置产能、价格不变且忽略挤出与政策反应。

不要混用税前与税后收入口径的边际倾向。

区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。

en.title: The Keynesian multiplier
en.takeaway: In a simple open-economy model, with marginal leakages measured against the same additional income, k = 1/(MPS + MPT + MPM). Income changes by k times the initial autonomous spending change.
en.definition: In a simple open-economy model, with marginal leakages measured against the same additional income, k = 1/(MPS + MPT + MPM). Income changes by k times the initial autonomous spending change.
causalChain: Autonomous spending creates first-round income
part funds further domestic spending
saving, taxes and imports shrink subsequent rounds
misconceptions: Do not mix marginal propensities measured against pre-tax and post-tax income.
examApplication: Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.
summary: In a simple open-economy model, with marginal leakages measured against the same additional income, k = 1/(MPS + MPT + MPM). Income changes by k times the initial autonomous spending change.
Do not mix marginal propensities measured against pre-tax and post-tax income.
en.explanation:
Autonomous spending creates first-round income.  part funds further domestic spending.  saving, taxes and imports shrink subsequent rounds.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: with all leakages measured against the same extra gross income, MPS=0.2, MPT=0.1 and MPM=0.2 give k=2, so ten of extra government purchases yields twenty of model income. In a closed model without government, k=1/(1−MPC). If c is consumption out of disposable income, t a proportional tax on gross income and m imports out of gross income, k=1/[1−c(1−t)+m]. Do not mix bases. Assume spare capacity, fixed prices and no crowding out or policy response.

Do not mix marginal propensities measured against pre-tax and post-tax income.

Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.

zh-CN.title: 挤出效应
zh-CN.takeaway: 政府扩张可能经利率、资源竞争或汇率挤出私人支出，但程度取决于产能、货币政策和融资条件，并非必然完全挤出。
zh-CN.definition: 政府扩张可能经利率、资源竞争或汇率挤出私人支出，但程度取决于产能、货币政策和融资条件，并非必然完全挤出。
causalChain: 政府扩张增加融资或资源需求
利率或投入成本可能上升
部分私人投资消费或净出口被抵消
misconceptions: 政府借款增加不能单独证明私人投资等额下降。
examApplication: 区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。
summary: 政府扩张可能经利率、资源竞争或汇率挤出私人支出，但程度取决于产能、货币政策和融资条件，并非必然完全挤出。
政府借款增加不能单独证明私人投资等额下降。
zh-CN.explanation:
政府扩张增加融资或资源需求。利率或投入成本可能上升。部分私人投资消费或净出口被抵消。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：满负荷时公共工程争夺建筑工人，私人项目成本上升；深度衰退且货币宽松时，这类压力可能较弱。改善运输的公共投资还可能降低企业成本，形成挤入，需区分短期与长期。

政府借款增加不能单独证明私人投资等额下降。

区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。

en.title: Crowding out
en.takeaway: Fiscal expansion may displace private spending through interest rates, competition for resources or exchange rates. Its extent depends on capacity, monetary policy and financing conditions; full crowding out is not inevitable.
en.definition: Fiscal expansion may displace private spending through interest rates, competition for resources or exchange rates. Its extent depends on capacity, monetary policy and financing conditions; full crowding out is not inevitable.
causalChain: Fiscal expansion raises financing or resource demand
interest rates or input costs may rise
some private investment, consumption or net exports are offset
misconceptions: Higher government borrowing alone does not prove an equal fall in private investment.
examApplication: Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.
summary: Fiscal expansion may displace private spending through interest rates, competition for resources or exchange rates. Its extent depends on capacity, monetary policy and financing conditions; full crowding out is not inevitable.
Higher government borrowing alone does not prove an equal fall in private investment.
en.explanation:
Fiscal expansion raises financing or resource demand.  interest rates or input costs may rise.  some private investment, consumption or net exports are offset.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: at capacity, public works compete for construction workers and raise private project costs. Such pressure may be weaker in a deep recession with monetary accommodation. Transport investment may also lower firms' costs and crowd investment in over time.

Higher government borrowing alone does not prove an equal fall in private investment.

Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.

zh-CN.title: 财政政策评价
zh-CN.takeaway: 财政评价应比较乘数、时滞、债务可持续性、分配和供给效应，并按经济状况与支出税收构成作条件性判断。
zh-CN.definition: 财政评价应比较乘数、时滞、债务可持续性、分配和供给效应，并按经济状况与支出税收构成作条件性判断。
causalChain: 判断产出缺口与政策目标
检查设计审批执行及漏出
权衡短期稳定与长期财政供给结果
misconceptions: 不能仅凭赤字大小或单一乘数宣布政策成功。
examApplication: 区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。
summary: 财政评价应比较乘数、时滞、债务可持续性、分配和供给效应，并按经济状况与支出税收构成作条件性判断。
不能仅凭赤字大小或单一乘数宣布政策成功。
zh-CN.explanation:
判断产出缺口与政策目标。检查设计审批执行及漏出。权衡短期稳定与长期财政供给结果。

### 原创情境与推导

原创例：快速现金支持可能较早稳定需求，建设铁路则准备期长却可能提高未来生产能力。高进口倾向会减少国内需求效应，但进口设备也能扩充供给。融资币种、利息与未来税基均关系债务风险。

不能仅凭赤字大小或单一乘数宣布政策成功。

区分购买与转移、流量与存量，评价漏出、时滞、挤出和债务。

en.title: Evaluating fiscal policy
en.takeaway: Fiscal evaluation compares multipliers, lags, debt sustainability, distribution and supply effects, reaching conditional conclusions based on economic conditions and the spending-tax mix.
en.definition: Fiscal evaluation compares multipliers, lags, debt sustainability, distribution and supply effects, reaching conditional conclusions based on economic conditions and the spending-tax mix.
causalChain: Identify the output gap and objective
examine design, approval, implementation and leakages
weigh short-run stabilisation against long-run fiscal and supply outcomes
misconceptions: Neither deficit size nor a single multiplier establishes policy success.
examApplication: Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.
summary: Fiscal evaluation compares multipliers, lags, debt sustainability, distribution and supply effects, reaching conditional conclusions based on economic conditions and the spending-tax mix.
Neither deficit size nor a single multiplier establishes policy success.
en.explanation:
Identify the output gap and objective.  examine design, approval, implementation and leakages.  weigh short-run stabilisation against long-run fiscal and supply outcomes.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: cash support may stabilise demand sooner, whereas rail construction has long preparation but may raise future capacity. High import propensity reduces domestic demand effects, yet imported equipment can expand supply. Financing currency, interest and future tax bases all matter for debt risk.

Neither deficit size nor a single multiplier establishes policy success.

Distinguish purchases/transfers and flows/stocks; evaluate leakages, lags, crowding out and debt.

zh-CN.title: 市场导向供给侧政策
zh-CN.takeaway: 竞争、适度放松管制、税收激励和私有化等政策试图改善资源配置与生产激励；成效取决于竞争环境和制度设计。
zh-CN.definition: 竞争、适度放松管制、税收激励和私有化等政策试图改善资源配置与生产激励；成效取决于竞争环境和制度设计。
causalChain: 改变竞争或激励约束
企业改善效率投资与创新
生产能力可能提高使长期总供给右移
misconceptions: 放松管制不应被理解为移除一切安全和环境规则。
examApplication: 解释生产率与潜在产出的渠道，区分短期 AD 与长期 AS，并评价机会成本。
summary: 竞争、适度放松管制、税收激励和私有化等政策试图改善资源配置与生产激励；成效取决于竞争环境和制度设计。
放松管制不应被理解为移除一切安全和环境规则。
zh-CN.explanation:
改变竞争或激励约束。企业改善效率投资与创新。生产能力可能提高使长期总供给右移。

原创例：减少新企业不必要的注册障碍可能增强竞争，但将公共垄断直接出售为私人垄断并不保证效率或可负担性改善。减税若没有带来新增投资，财政收入损失未必换来预期产能。

放松管制不应被理解为移除一切安全和环境规则。

解释生产率与潜在产出的渠道，区分短期 AD 与长期 AS，并评价机会成本。

en.title: Market-based supply-side policies
en.takeaway: Competition, appropriate deregulation, tax incentives and privatisation seek to improve allocation and production incentives. Results depend on competitive conditions and institutional design.

en.explanation:
Change competitive or incentive constraints.  firms improve efficiency, investment and innovation.  productive capacity may rise and LRAS shift right.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: removing unnecessary entry barriers may strengthen competition, but selling a public monopoly as a private monopoly does not guarantee efficiency or affordability. Tax cuts that fail to induce investment may lose revenue without delivering expected capacity.

Deregulation need not mean removing all safety and environmental rules.

Explain productivity and potential-output channels, distinguish short-run AD from long-run AS and evaluate opportunity costs.

zh-CN.definition: 教育、培训、医疗、基础设施和研发支持旨在提升生产率与潜在产出，常针对外部收益、信息或协调失灵。

投入金额不是生产率改善的充分证据。

解释生产率与潜在产出的渠道，区分短期 AD 与长期 AS，并评价机会成本。

en.title: Interventionist supply-side policies
en.takeaway: Education, training, health, infrastructure and research support aim to raise productivity and potential output, often addressing external benefits, information or coordination failures.
en.definition: Education, training, health, infrastructure and research support aim to raise productivity and potential output, often addressing external benefits, information or coordination failures.
causalChain: Identify skill, health or capital bottlenecks
public services and investment improve production conditions
productivity and potential output may increase over time
misconceptions: Spending amounts are not sufficient evidence of productivity gains.
examApplication: Explain productivity and potential-output channels, distinguish short-run AD from long-run AS and evaluate opportunity costs.
summary: Education, training, health, infrastructure and research support aim to raise productivity and potential output, often addressing external benefits, information or coordination failures.
Spending amounts are not sufficient evidence of productivity gains.
en.explanation:
Identify skill, health or capital bottlenecks.  public services and investment improve production conditions.  productivity and potential output may increase over time.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: training aligned with actual vacancies may reduce mismatch, whereas courses without employer demand may not increase employment. Education spending can raise current demand, but supports long-run supply only if skills and productivity improve, often after a long lag.

Spending amounts are not sufficient evidence of productivity gains.

Explain productivity and potential-output channels, distinguish short-run AD from long-run AS and evaluate opportunity costs.

zh-CN.definition: 培训、就业信息、流动性支持与劳动制度改革可影响就业匹配和激励；效率、收入保障及劳动权利需要共同评价。

可持续就业增加并可能降低自然失业率

examApplication: 解释生产率与潜在产出的渠道，区分短期 AD 与长期 AS，并评价机会成本。
summary: 培训、就业信息、流动性支持与劳动制度改革可影响就业匹配和激励；效率、收入保障及劳动权利需要共同评价。

培训不直接解决总需求不足造成的所有周期性失业。

en.title: Labour-market policies

en.definition: Training, job information, mobility support and labour reforms can affect matching and incentives. Evaluate efficiency alongside income security and labour rights.

improve matching, skills or regional mobility
sustainable employment rises and the natural unemployment rate may fall
misconceptions: Training does not directly solve all cyclical unemployment caused by weak demand.
examApplication: Explain productivity and potential-output channels, distinguish short-run AD from long-run AS and evaluate opportunity costs.
summary: Training, job information, mobility support and labour reforms can affect matching and incentives. Evaluate efficiency alongside income security and labour rights.
Training does not directly solve all cyclical unemployment caused by weak demand.
en.explanation:
Diagnose frictional or structural unemployment.  improve matching, skills or regional mobility.  sustainable employment rises and the natural unemployment rate may fall.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: public vacancy platforms improve information and relocation support aids regional job search, but housing costs and caring duties may still restrict mobility. Weaker protections may lower some hiring costs while increasing insecurity; lower wages alone are not a complete evaluation.

Training does not directly solve all cyclical unemployment caused by weak demand.

Explain productivity and potential-output channels, distinguish short-run AD from long-run AS and evaluate opportunity costs.

zh-CN.definition: 交通、数字网络和研发可提高生产率并产生外部收益；项目应按额外收益、机会成本、维护和治理能力评价。

长期供给增加但收益取决于使用与维护

增加投资流量不保证资本服务质量和长期回报。

识别网络或知识瓶颈。投资降低成本或扩大技术能力。长期供给增加但收益取决于使用与维护。

原创例：可靠电网减少停机时间，研发支持可能促进知识溢出。然而低利用率工程、寻租或缺乏维护可能使成本超过收益。研发结果不确定，不能把每一笔补贴都视作新增创新。

增加投资流量不保证资本服务质量和长期回报。

解释生产率与潜在产出的渠道，区分短期 AD 与长期 AS，并评价机会成本。

en.title: Infrastructure and innovation
en.takeaway: Transport, digital networks and research can raise productivity and generate external benefits. Evaluate additional benefits, opportunity costs, maintenance and governance.
en.definition: Transport, digital networks and research can raise productivity and generate external benefits. Evaluate additional benefits, opportunity costs, maintenance and governance.
causalChain: Identify network or knowledge bottlenecks
investment lowers costs or expands technological capability
long-run supply grows but benefits depend on use and maintenance

examApplication: Explain productivity and potential-output channels, distinguish short-run AD from long-run AS and evaluate opportunity costs.
summary: Transport, digital networks and research can raise productivity and generate external benefits. Evaluate additional benefits, opportunity costs, maintenance and governance.
Higher investment flows do not guarantee capital-service quality or long-run returns.
en.explanation:
Identify network or knowledge bottlenecks.  investment lowers costs or expands technological capability.  long-run supply grows but benefits depend on use and maintenance.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: reliable electricity reduces downtime, while research support may generate knowledge spillovers. Underused projects, rent-seeking or poor maintenance can make costs exceed benefits. Research outcomes are uncertain; not every subsidy produces additional innovation.

Higher investment flows do not guarantee capital-service quality or long-run returns.

zh-CN.definition: 需求管理与供给改革作用于不同机制和时间尺度，应按冲击来源、产能、分配、环境与财政金融约束组合使用。

没有脱离经济情境的万能政策排名。

解释生产率与潜在产出的渠道，区分短期 AD 与长期 AS，并评价机会成本。

en.title: Macroeconomic policy mixes
en.takeaway: Demand management and supply reforms operate through different mechanisms and time horizons. Combine them according to shocks, capacity, distribution, environment and fiscal-financial constraints.
en.definition: Demand management and supply reforms operate through different mechanisms and time horizons. Combine them according to shocks, capacity, distribution, environment and fiscal-financial constraints.
causalChain: Diagnose weak demand or supply bottlenecks
coordinate short-run stabilisation with long-run capacity policies
evaluate net effects across objectives and time horizons
misconceptions: There is no context-free ranking of universally best policies.

summary: Demand management and supply reforms operate through different mechanisms and time horizons. Combine them according to shocks, capacity, distribution, environment and fiscal-financial constraints.
There is no context-free ranking of universally best policies.
en.explanation:
Diagnose weak demand or supply bottlenecks.  coordinate short-run stabilisation with long-run capacity policies.  evaluate net effects across objectives and time horizons.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Illustrative example: weak demand alongside skills mismatch can justify short-run demand support with long-run training; training alone may not immediately create jobs. In an overheated economy, stimulating demand may worsen inflation before new capacity arrives, so sequencing and implementation matter.

There is no context-free ranking of universally best policies.

Explain productivity and potential-output channels, distinguish short-run AD from long-run AS and evaluate opportunity costs.

zh-CN.title: 商业银行的货币创造

zh-CN.definition: 商业银行发放贷款通常同时创造客户存款；贷款偿还可销毁存款货币，但资本、流动性、风险、监管与贷款需求约束扩张。
causalChain: 银行记入贷款资产
同时记入客户存款负债
跨行支付需要结算与流动性

summary: 商业银行发放贷款通常同时创造客户存款；贷款偿还可销毁存款货币，但资本、流动性、风险、监管与贷款需求约束扩张。
不能把新增存款等同于新增产出，也不能把创造货币理解为银行没有风险约束。

银行记入贷款资产。同时记入客户存款负债。跨行支付需要结算与流动性。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：银行贷出 100，同时客户存款增加 100；客户净财富没有因此增加 100，因为还负有贷款。基础货币与广义货币不同，准备金不是可无限机械倍增的保证。

不能把新增存款等同于新增产出，也不能把创造货币理解为银行没有风险约束。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Money creation by commercial banks
en.takeaway: Commercial-bank lending normally creates a matching deposit; principal repayment can destroy deposit money. Capital, liquidity, risk, regulation and loan demand constrain expansion.
en.definition: Commercial-bank lending normally creates a matching deposit; principal repayment can destroy deposit money. Capital, liquidity, risk, regulation and loan demand constrain expansion.
causalChain: The bank records a loan asset
it records a matching deposit liability
interbank payments need settlement and liquidity
misconceptions: New deposits are not new output, and money creation does not make banks unconstrained.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: Commercial-bank lending normally creates a matching deposit; principal repayment can destroy deposit money. Capital, liquidity, risk, regulation and loan demand constrain expansion.
New deposits are not new output, and money creation does not make banks unconstrained.
en.explanation:
The bank records a loan asset.  it records a matching deposit liability.  interbank payments need settlement and liquidity.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: lending 100 adds a deposit of 100 but also a debt of 100, so it does not add 100 to the borrower’s net wealth. Base and broad money differ; reserves do not guarantee unlimited mechanical expansion.

New deposits are not new output, and money creation does not make banks unconstrained.

Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.

zh-CN.definition: 公开市场操作、准备金要求和央行贷款利率可影响金融条件；具体传导取决于银行体系与政策实施框架。

银行资金成本与流动性变化
信贷和利率渠道影响支出

summary: 公开市场操作、准备金要求和央行贷款利率可影响金融条件；具体传导取决于银行体系与政策实施框架。
不要把央行买金融资产记为财政政策中政府购买商品服务的 G。

央行调整工具。银行资金成本与流动性变化。信贷和利率渠道影响支出。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：央行买债可增加银行结算余额，在其他条件适当时压低市场收益率；降低准备金要求可能释放流动性，但不保证银行放贷或家庭借款增加。QE 通常针对较长期资产。

不要把央行买金融资产记为财政政策中政府购买商品服务的 G。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: Monetary policy instruments

en.definition: Open-market operations, reserve requirements and central-bank lending rates can affect financial conditions; transmission depends on the banking system and operating framework.

Do not record central-bank purchases of financial assets as fiscal purchases of goods and services in G.

The central bank adjusts instruments.  bank funding costs and liquidity change.  credit and interest channels affect spending.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: bond purchases can add settlement balances and, under suitable conditions, lower yields. Lower reserve requirements may ease liquidity without guaranteeing more lending or borrowing. QE often targets longer-term assets.

Do not record central-bank purchases of financial assets as fiscal purchases of goods and services in G.

zh-CN.definition: 在简单流动性偏好模型中，货币需求随持币机会成本即名义利率上升而下降；给定货币供给与需求交点确定利率。

summary: 在简单流动性偏好模型中，货币需求随持币机会成本即名义利率上升而下降；给定货币供给与需求交点确定利率。
货币市场纵轴是名义利率，横轴是货币数量，不是商品价格与产量。

利率提高持币机会成本。货币需求量下降。供需交点形成模型均衡。

货币市场纵轴是名义利率，横轴是货币数量，不是商品价格与产量。

用利率到支出再到 AD 的链条解释传导，注明汇率制度、时滞与限制。

en.title: The money market and equilibrium interest
en.takeaway: In a simple liquidity-preference model, money demand falls as the nominal interest opportunity cost of holding money rises. Its intersection with given money supply determines interest.
en.definition: In a simple liquidity-preference model, money demand falls as the nominal interest opportunity cost of holding money rises. Its intersection with given money supply determines interest.
causalChain: Interest raises the opportunity cost of money
quantity of money demanded falls
demand and supply intersect at model equilibrium
misconceptions: The axes are nominal interest and money quantity, not a good’s price and output.
examApplication: Trace rates through spending to AD, stating exchange-rate arrangements, lags and limitations.
summary: In a simple liquidity-preference model, money demand falls as the nominal interest opportunity cost of holding money rises. Its intersection with given money supply determines interest.
The axes are nominal interest and money quantity, not a good’s price and output.
en.explanation:
Interest raises the opportunity cost of money.  quantity of money demanded falls.  demand and supply intersect at model equilibrium.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: holding income and prices constant, a rightward money-supply shift lowers equilibrium interest. Actual central banks may target a policy rate directly; the schematic is not every system’s daily operating process.

zh-CN.title: 管理浮动与干预
zh-CN.takeaway: 管理浮动允许市场定价并由当局选择性干预；相对于维持目标或基本面基准，货币可被视为高估或低估。不同制度的优劣比较属于 HL。

原创假设：本币面临升值，当局卖本币买外币可限制升幅并增加储备；面对贬值压力则可反向操作，但储备有限。高估和低估均须说明比较基准。

### Original scenario and reasoning

en.title: Exchange regimes and policy constraints

en.definition: With free capital mobility, a fixed exchange rate constrains independent monetary policy: interest differentials trigger flows requiring intervention or policy adjustment.

zh-CN.title: 经常账户的构成

声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。

en.title: Balance-of-payments identity and signs
en.takeaway: With a teaching convention that defines FA as net financial inflows, CA+KA+FA+errors=0. The official net-acquisition-of-assets-minus-liabilities convention uses the opposite FA sign.
en.definition: With a teaching convention that defines FA as net financial inflows, CA+KA+FA+errors=0. The official net-acquisition-of-assets-minus-liabilities convention uses the opposite FA sign.
causalChain: State the financial-account sign convention
record transaction counterparts
use errors and omissions for statistical discrepancies
misconceptions: Do not count reserves inside FA and then add them again; balanced accounts do not imply a zero current account.
examApplication: Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.
summary: With a teaching convention that defines FA as net financial inflows, CA+KA+FA+errors=0. The official net-acquisition-of-assets-minus-liabilities convention uses the opposite FA sign.
Do not count reserves inside FA and then add them again; balanced accounts do not imply a zero current account.
en.explanation:
State the financial-account sign convention.  record transaction counterparts.  use errors and omissions for statistical discrepancies.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: CA=−30, KA=0 and no errors imply teaching-convention inflows FA=+30, or official net-lending FA=−30. Reserve transactions are already within the financial account.

Do not count reserves inside FA and then add them again; balanced accounts do not imply a zero current account.

Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.

zh-CN.title: 经常账户失衡的原因与可持续性
zh-CN.takeaway: 经常账户逆差可能反映投资进口、竞争力不足或内需强劲；其可持续性取决于融资结构、偿债能力与资金用途。
zh-CN.definition: 经常账户逆差可能反映投资进口、竞争力不足或内需强劲；其可持续性取决于融资结构、偿债能力与资金用途。
causalChain: 进口或收入支付超过相应收入
外部融资或储备变化对应缺口
未来收益与融资稳定性决定风险
misconceptions: 逆差不必然坏，顺差也可能反映内需不足；应比较规模、期限、币种与结构。
examApplication: 声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。
summary: 经常账户逆差可能反映投资进口、竞争力不足或内需强劲；其可持续性取决于融资结构、偿债能力与资金用途。
逆差不必然坏，顺差也可能反映内需不足；应比较规模、期限、币种与结构。
zh-CN.explanation:
进口或收入支付超过相应收入。外部融资或储备变化对应缺口。未来收益与融资稳定性决定风险。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：设备进口支持未来出口，与短期外币借款资助消费具有不同风险；长期直接投资通常比易撤出的短期融资更稳定。

逆差不必然坏，顺差也可能反映内需不足；应比较规模、期限、币种与结构。

声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。

en.title: Causes and sustainability of current-account imbalances
en.takeaway: A current deficit may reflect investment imports, weak competitiveness or strong domestic demand. Sustainability depends on financing structure, repayment capacity and how funds are used.
en.definition: A current deficit may reflect investment imports, weak competitiveness or strong domestic demand. Sustainability depends on financing structure, repayment capacity and how funds are used.
causalChain: Imports or income payments exceed receipts
external financing or reserves correspond to the gap
future returns and financing stability determine risks
misconceptions: Deficits are not automatically bad, nor surpluses always good; compare size, maturity, currency and structure.
examApplication: Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.
summary: A current deficit may reflect investment imports, weak competitiveness or strong domestic demand. Sustainability depends on financing structure, repayment capacity and how funds are used.
Deficits are not automatically bad, nor surpluses always good; compare size, maturity, currency and structure.
en.explanation:
Imports or income payments exceed receipts.  external financing or reserves correspond to the gap.  future returns and financing stability determine risks.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: machinery imports supporting future exports differ from short-term foreign-currency borrowing funding consumption. Long-term direct investment is generally more stable than easily reversed short-term finance.

Deficits are not automatically bad, nor surpluses always good; compare size, maturity, currency and structure.

Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.

zh-CN.title: 马歇尔—勒纳条件
zh-CN.takeaway: 在初始贸易平衡等标准假设下，贬值改善贸易余额要求出口与进口需求价格弹性的绝对值之和大于 1。
zh-CN.definition: 在初始贸易平衡等标准假设下，贬值改善贸易余额要求出口与进口需求价格弹性的绝对值之和大于 1。
causalChain: 贬值改变相对价格
数量按需求弹性调整
数量效应超过进口单位成本效应时余额改善
misconceptions: 条件针对贸易余额，不自动覆盖投资收益和转移；弹性不是百分比数量变化本身。
examApplication: 声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。
summary: 在初始贸易平衡等标准假设下，贬值改善贸易余额要求出口与进口需求价格弹性的绝对值之和大于 1。
条件针对贸易余额，不自动覆盖投资收益和转移；弹性不是百分比数量变化本身。
zh-CN.explanation:
贬值改变相对价格。数量按需求弹性调整。数量效应超过进口单位成本效应时余额改善。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：出口弹性 0.7、进口弹性 0.6，总和 1.3，在充分供给反应和相关模型假设下支持改善；不意味着一定立即改善。

条件针对贸易余额，不自动覆盖投资收益和转移；弹性不是百分比数量变化本身。

声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。

en.title: The Marshall–Lerner condition
en.takeaway: Under standard assumptions including initial trade balance, depreciation improves the trade balance when absolute export and import demand elasticities sum to more than one.
en.definition: Under standard assumptions including initial trade balance, depreciation improves the trade balance when absolute export and import demand elasticities sum to more than one.
causalChain: Depreciation changes relative prices
volumes respond to demand elasticities
the balance improves when volume effects outweigh the import unit-cost effect
misconceptions: The condition concerns the trade balance, not all income and transfers; an elasticity is not the quantity percentage change itself.
examApplication: Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.
summary: Under standard assumptions including initial trade balance, depreciation improves the trade balance when absolute export and import demand elasticities sum to more than one.
The condition concerns the trade balance, not all income and transfers; an elasticity is not the quantity percentage change itself.
en.explanation:
Depreciation changes relative prices.  volumes respond to demand elasticities.  the balance improves when volume effects outweigh the import unit-cost effect.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: elasticities 0.7 and 0.6 sum to 1.3, supporting improvement with sufficient supply response and the model's assumptions; improvement need not be immediate.

The condition concerns the trade balance, not all income and transfers; an elasticity is not the quantity percentage change itself.

Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.

zh-CN.title: J 曲线与调整时滞
zh-CN.takeaway: 贬值后贸易余额可能先恶化后改善，因为合同与消费习惯使数量反应滞后于进口价格变化。
zh-CN.definition: 贬值后贸易余额可能先恶化后改善，因为合同与消费习惯使数量反应滞后于进口价格变化。
causalChain: 进口本币单价先上升
短期合同使数量调整缓慢
长期弹性增大可能改善余额
misconceptions: J 形只是可能路径；若长期弹性不足或供给受限，余额可能始终不改善。
examApplication: 声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。
summary: 贬值后贸易余额可能先恶化后改善，因为合同与消费习惯使数量反应滞后于进口价格变化。
J 形只是可能路径；若长期弹性不足或供给受限，余额可能始终不改善。
zh-CN.explanation:
进口本币单价先上升。短期合同使数量调整缓慢。长期弹性增大可能改善余额。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：进口燃料合同量短期固定，贬值先增加账单；之后企业节能并改用本地投入，进口量才下降。

J 形只是可能路径；若长期弹性不足或供给受限，余额可能始终不改善。

声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。

en.title: The J-curve and adjustment lags
en.takeaway: After depreciation the trade balance may first worsen and later improve because contracts and habits delay quantity responses relative to import-price changes.
en.definition: After depreciation the trade balance may first worsen and later improve because contracts and habits delay quantity responses relative to import-price changes.
causalChain: Home-currency import prices rise first
contracts slow initial volume adjustment
higher long-run elasticities may improve the balance
misconceptions: The J shape is only a possible path; weak long-run elasticities or supply constraints can prevent improvement.
examApplication: Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.
summary: After depreciation the trade balance may first worsen and later improve because contracts and habits delay quantity responses relative to import-price changes.
The J shape is only a possible path; weak long-run elasticities or supply constraints can prevent improvement.
en.explanation:
Home-currency import prices rise first.  contracts slow initial volume adjustment.  higher long-run elasticities may improve the balance.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: contracted fuel volumes initially remain fixed, so depreciation raises the bill first. Firms later conserve energy and substitute domestic inputs, reducing imports.

The J shape is only a possible path; weak long-run elasticities or supply constraints can prevent improvement.

Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.

zh-CN.title: 支出转换、支出减少与供给侧措施
zh-CN.takeaway: 经常账户政策可转换支出来源、减少总支出或改善供给竞争力，各有时滞和宏观目标代价。
zh-CN.definition: 经常账户政策可转换支出来源、减少总支出或改善供给竞争力，各有时滞和宏观目标代价。

生产率政策改善长期竞争力

zh-CN.explanation:
转换政策改变相对价格。紧缩减少进口需求。生产率政策改善长期竞争力。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：加息压低消费和进口可能缩小逆差，却增加失业且可能吸引资本升值；培训与物流改善较慢但可提高出口能力。

不能忽略汇率的反向渠道，也不能把需求压缩导致的逆差改善当作无成本成功。

声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。

productivity policy improves long-run competitiveness

summary: Current-account policies can switch spending sources, reduce total expenditure or improve supply competitiveness, each with lags and macroeconomic trade-offs.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: higher rates may cut consumption and imports but raise unemployment and attract appreciating capital flows. Training and logistics take longer but can improve export capacity.

zh-CN.title: 增长、发展与可持续性
zh-CN.takeaway: 经济发展涵盖健康、教育、机会和生活质量；可持续发展要求满足当前需要而不损害后代满足需要的能力。
zh-CN.definition: 经济发展涵盖健康、教育、机会和生活质量；可持续发展要求满足当前需要而不损害后代满足需要的能力。

自然资本保护维持未来选择

产出增长扩大可用资源。分配与公共服务影响能力。自然资本保护维持未来选择。

原创假设：采矿提高 GDP，但污染水源并挤压农业，不能只用产出增长判断发展；需衡量健康、收入分配和生态损失。

增长可能资助发展，但并非充分条件；可持续性也包含代际公平。

连接当代、代际公平与自然资本，说明政策协同、机会成本和可观察指标。

en.title: Growth, development and sustainability
en.takeaway: Development concerns health, education, opportunity and quality of life. Sustainable development meets present needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet theirs.
en.definition: Development concerns health, education, opportunity and quality of life. Sustainable development meets present needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet theirs.

Hypothetical scenario: mining raises GDP but pollutes water and harms farming. Evaluate health, distribution and ecological losses alongside output.

Growth can finance development but is not sufficient; sustainability includes intergenerational equity.

Connect current and intergenerational equity with natural capital, explaining synergies, opportunity costs and observable indicators.

连接当代、代际公平与自然资本，说明政策协同、机会成本和可观察指标。

en.title: Poverty, environment and common resources
en.takeaway: Poverty can push households toward short-run resource extraction, while degradation undermines livelihoods. Property rights, alternative incomes and public services influence the cycle.
en.definition: Poverty can push households toward short-run resource extraction, while degradation undermines livelihoods. Property rights, alternative incomes and public services influence the cycle.

degradation makes income more vulnerable

zh-CN.title: 可持续发展目标与政策权衡

### Original scenario and reasoning

World Bank SH.DYN.MORT data, checked 2026-10-18 and sourced from the UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation: under-five deaths per 1,000 live births were 36.6 in China in 2000 and 6.6 in 2022; India recorded 91.8 and 29.5. Both declined but differed in starting levels, reductions and final levels. This concerns SDG 3 child health, not achievement of all health goals. Source: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.DYN.MORT?locations=CN-IN .

Per 1,000 live births is not a population percentage; national averages hide regional gaps and estimates can be revised.

Match policy to constraints; evaluate implementation, finance, lags, equity and sustainability, then give a conditional judgement.

zh-CN.title: 持续经常账户顺差的影响
zh-CN.takeaway: 经常账户顺差可能伴随对外资产积累、强出口或国内支出不足；其就业、汇率和通胀影响依赖产能、制度与资本流。
zh-CN.definition: 经常账户顺差可能伴随对外资产积累、强出口或国内支出不足；其就业、汇率和通胀影响依赖产能、制度与资本流。
causalChain: 国外净需求支持本国产出
资金与储备流形成对应
汇率和内需调整改变未来顺差
misconceptions: 顺差不自动等于最优，也不保证本币一定升值；需考虑金融流与干预。
examApplication: 声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。
summary: 经常账户顺差可能伴随对外资产积累、强出口或国内支出不足；其就业、汇率和通胀影响依赖产能、制度与资本流。
顺差不自动等于最优，也不保证本币一定升值；需考虑金融流与干预。
zh-CN.explanation:
国外净需求支持本国产出。资金与储备流形成对应。汇率和内需调整改变未来顺差。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：出口需求旺盛可提高就业并推动浮动本币升值，削弱价格竞争力；另一国顺差却可能来自衰退中的进口下降。政府积累外汇储备可改变升值路径。

顺差不自动等于最优，也不保证本币一定升值；需考虑金融流与干预。

声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。

en.title: Implications of persistent current-account surpluses
en.takeaway: A current-account surplus may accompany foreign-asset accumulation, strong exports or weak domestic spending. Employment, exchange-rate and inflation effects depend on capacity, regimes and capital flows.
en.definition: A current-account surplus may accompany foreign-asset accumulation, strong exports or weak domestic spending. Employment, exchange-rate and inflation effects depend on capacity, regimes and capital flows.
causalChain: Net foreign demand supports home output
financial and reserve flows form counterparts
currency and domestic-demand adjustment affect future surpluses
misconceptions: A surplus is not automatically optimal and does not guarantee appreciation; financial flows and intervention matter.
examApplication: Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.
summary: A current-account surplus may accompany foreign-asset accumulation, strong exports or weak domestic spending. Employment, exchange-rate and inflation effects depend on capacity, regimes and capital flows.
A surplus is not automatically optimal and does not guarantee appreciation; financial flows and intervention matter.
en.explanation:
Net foreign demand supports home output.  financial and reserve flows form counterparts.  currency and domestic-demand adjustment affect future surpluses.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: strong exports may support employment and appreciate a floating currency, weakening price competitiveness. Another economy’s surplus may instead reflect recession-driven import compression. Reserve accumulation can alter appreciation.

A surplus is not automatically optimal and does not guarantee appreciation; financial flows and intervention matter.

Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.

zh-CN.title: 外部账户与汇率的联系
zh-CN.takeaway: 出口收入与对本国资产的需求可增加本币需求，进口与对外资产购买可增加本币供给；不同账户资金流共同影响汇率，因果也可反向。
zh-CN.definition: 出口收入与对本国资产的需求可增加本币需求，进口与对外资产购买可增加本币供给；不同账户资金流共同影响汇率，因果也可反向。
causalChain: 交易形成货币买卖
经常和金融流共同作用
汇率调整又影响贸易与资产回报
misconceptions: 会计恒等式不证明贸易逆差单独决定汇率，需说明时序和其他条件。
examApplication: 声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。
summary: 出口收入与对本国资产的需求可增加本币需求，进口与对外资产购买可增加本币供给；不同账户资金流共同影响汇率，因果也可反向。
会计恒等式不证明贸易逆差单独决定汇率，需说明时序和其他条件。
zh-CN.explanation:
交易形成货币买卖。经常和金融流共同作用。汇率调整又影响贸易与资产回报。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：经常账户逆差造成的本币卖压可被外国资产购买形成的资本流入抵消，因此不一定贬值；在固定汇率下，储备操作也会改变结果。

会计恒等式不证明贸易逆差单独决定汇率，需说明时序和其他条件。

声明金融账户符号和储备处理；区分贸易余额与经常账户、会计恒等式与经济因果。

en.title: External accounts and exchange rates
en.takeaway: Export receipts and demand for home assets can raise currency demand, while imports and foreign-asset purchases can raise its supply. Flows across accounts jointly affect exchange rates, with causation also running in reverse.
en.definition: Export receipts and demand for home assets can raise currency demand, while imports and foreign-asset purchases can raise its supply. Flows across accounts jointly affect exchange rates, with causation also running in reverse.
causalChain: Transactions generate currency purchases and sales
current and financial flows interact
exchange changes affect trade and asset returns in turn
misconceptions: An accounting identity does not prove a trade deficit alone determines the exchange rate; specify timing and other conditions.
examApplication: Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.
summary: Export receipts and demand for home assets can raise currency demand, while imports and foreign-asset purchases can raise its supply. Flows across accounts jointly affect exchange rates, with causation also running in reverse.
An accounting identity does not prove a trade deficit alone determines the exchange rate; specify timing and other conditions.
en.explanation:
Transactions generate currency purchases and sales.  current and financial flows interact.  exchange changes affect trade and asset returns in turn.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: currency selling associated with a current deficit can be offset by foreign purchases of home assets. Depreciation need not follow; reserve transactions also matter under a peg.

An accounting identity does not prove a trade deficit alone determines the exchange rate; specify timing and other conditions.

Declare the financial-account sign and reserve treatment; distinguish trade from current balances and accounting identities from economic causation.

zh-CN.title: 贸易条件指数（扩展）
zh-CN.takeaway: 贸易条件指数为出口价格指数除以进口价格指数再乘 100，描述一单位出口交换进口的相对价格；本卡作为扩展，不标作本考纲必修计算。
zh-CN.definition: 贸易条件指数为出口价格指数除以进口价格指数再乘 100，描述一单位出口交换进口的相对价格；本卡作为扩展，不标作本考纲必修计算。
causalChain: 比较出口与进口价格
计算同基期指数之比
用数量与成本补充解释收入
misconceptions: 不要把贸易条件指数当汇率或出口额除进口额。
examApplication: 解释障碍如何相互强化，识别主要约束，避免对国家或群体作决定论推断。
summary: 贸易条件指数为出口价格指数除以进口价格指数再乘 100，描述一单位出口交换进口的相对价格；本卡作为扩展，不标作本考纲必修计算。
不要把贸易条件指数当汇率或出口额除进口额。
zh-CN.explanation:
比较出口与进口价格。计算同基期指数之比。用数量与成本补充解释收入。

### 原创情境与推导

原创假设：出口价指数 90、进口价指数 120，贸易条件为 75；这不是贸易余额 −25，也不单独决定出口总收入。

不要把贸易条件指数当汇率或出口额除进口额。

解释障碍如何相互强化，识别主要约束，避免对国家或群体作决定论推断。

en.title: Terms-of-trade index (enrichment)
en.takeaway: The terms-of-trade index is the export price index divided by the import price index times 100, describing relative export purchasing power. This card is enrichment, not labelled a required calculation in this syllabus.
en.definition: The terms-of-trade index is the export price index divided by the import price index times 100, describing relative export purchasing power. This card is enrichment, not labelled a required calculation in this syllabus.
causalChain: Compare export and import prices
divide indices with the same base
add quantities and costs to explain receipts
misconceptions: Do not confuse terms of trade with an exchange rate or exports divided by imports.
examApplication: Explain reinforcing barriers, identify binding constraints and avoid deterministic claims about countries or groups.
summary: The terms-of-trade index is the export price index divided by the import price index times 100, describing relative export purchasing power. This card is enrichment, not labelled a required calculation in this syllabus.
Do not confuse terms of trade with an exchange rate or exports divided by imports.
en.explanation:
Compare export and import prices.  divide indices with the same base.  add quantities and costs to explain receipts.

### Original scenario and reasoning

Hypothetical scenario: export price index ninety and import price index 120 give terms of trade 75. This is not a trade balance of −25 and does not alone determine export receipts.

Do not confuse terms of trade with an exchange rate or exports divided by imports.

Explain reinforcing barriers, identify binding constraints and avoid deterministic claims about countries or groups.
